digest.component_or_area: transition / close-reason plumbing across CLI, library, and MCP
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing rules are independently computed across three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with different admission and normalization semantics, including an asymmetry where CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them.

The placeholder string '(no reason given)' is produced and consumed across five code sites in three files with no single canonical source, and the MCP surface does not expose reason parameter at all, blocking write-parity.

Implementation must converge the CLI refusal behavior uniformly across library and MCP without allowing the placeholder to reach close_disposition.verdict, which would incorrectly sign unjustified dispositions.
A bare --force on a reason-required class must remain accepted after refactoring, requiring the empty-reason-to-placeholder normalization to occur before the refusal check, not after.
